item.title: SolidCraft 0.42.0 reference snapshot
item.description:
This directory is the immutable, version-pinned SolidCraft 0.42.0 engineering reference used for Forge compatibility and qualification.

  • SolidCraft release: v0.42.0
  • Upstream repository: tangency-labs/solidcraft
  • Upstream commit: 1b1e940cc48e4d1d5d01971a4be20e2e55647066

Checked-in reference material

This qualified version tree contains:

  • commands.md — the human-readable SolidCraft command catalog snapshot;
  • contract-gaps.md — known typed-contract gaps relevant to Forge;
  • joint-occurrence-references.md — qualified joint/occurrence reference behavior;
  • occurrence-identity.md — qualified occurrence identity behavior;
  • rectangular-feature-patterns.md — version-specific rectangular-pattern notes;
  • sketch-slot-family.md — version-specific native slot notes.

An earlier qualification implementation also generated machine-readable runtime/manifest.json, runtime/commands.json and runtime/contracts/<command-id>.json snapshots. Those generated files and the snapshot generator were removed during the later CI/runtime cleanup and are not part of the current repository tree. Do not rely on the stale historical path. The retained files above are the current checked-in 0.42.0 reference evidence.

Upgrade rule

Keep all 0.42.0 evidence unchanged once qualified. When Forge targets a later SolidCraft release, add a new sibling version directory first, record its exact upstream provenance and capture the new version-specific reference material before compatibility work begins.

See ../README.md and ../../../development.md for the current procedure.

item.title: SolidCraft 0.45.0 canonical reference snapshot
item.description:
This directory is generated from the command registry emitted by the qualified immutable SolidCraft runtime. It is not a hand-authored Forge migration note.

  • SolidCraft release: v0.45.0
  • Upstream commit: e8ce12ef78fe76281a04b7242a9ce059ff7d5067
  • Qualified runtime release: v0.3.4
  • Qualified runtime image: ghcr.io/brainboxemb/cad-solidcraft:v0.3.4
  • Captured CLI version: solidcraft-cli 0.45.0
  • Registered commands: 819

Canonical evidence

  • commands.json is the exact normalized JSON registry captured from solidcraft-cli commands in the immutable runtime.
  • commands.md is generated from commands.json for human review.
  • changes-from-0.42.md compares command identifiers with the retained historical 0.42.0 catalog.

Forge compatibility conclusions must be traceable to this captured registry, the exact runtime behavior, or separately recorded upstream source evidence. Do not replace this directory with a manually selected command subset.
